content: Implemented common PCM WAV decoding, SHA-256 managed asset fingerprints, copy/reference import modes with project-relative paths, waveform metadata/peak cache, deterministic duplicate detection, and structured missing/changed source diagnostics. Validation: `cargo test -p jutsu-audio-project --test asset_manager` (4 passed) and `cargo quality` (all format, Clippy -D warnings, 35 tests, and bench compilation passed).
